films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical teaser showcasing a sleek, futuristic sneaker floating through iconic brutalist architecture in Skopje.
films.music: Fast-paced electronic trap beat with heavy bass, 130 bpm
vo_mk: Освој го градот со секој нов чекор.

shots.kf: Centered in a vertical 9:16 frame, a futuristic, unbranded metallic-silver and neon-orange sneaker floats in mid-air. The background is the iconic brutalist concrete architecture of the Skopje Post Office. Dramatic sunset lighting casting deep shadows. Wide angle lens, cyberpunk aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sneaker rotates slowly on its vertical axis. The camera pushes in slightly towards the shoe.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of the sneaker's textured, neon-orange glowing sole, hovering just inches above wet, dark asphalt. Reflected city lights shimmer in the puddles. Centered vertical 9:16 framing, macro lens, shallow depth of field, high contrast lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Water ripples in the puddle beneath the sole. The camera slowly pans downwards along the shoe's profile.

shots.kf: Low angle vertical 9:16 shot of the silver and orange sneaker resting firmly on a sleek concrete pedestal at the top of Mount Vodno, with a blurred panoramic view of the Skopje skyline at dusk. Neon edge-lighting, premium commercial look, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A subtle burst of dust settles around the base of the shoe. The camera slowly arcs around the sneaker.

films.desc_en: A premium, cinematic explainer revealing the elegant extraction process of a state-of-the-art espresso machine in a modern Macedonian villa.
films.music: Smooth ambient electronic lounge, warm atmospheric pads, 90 bpm
vo_mk: Откријте ја новата димензија на утринското кафе.
Прецизната технологија го извлекува најдоброто од секое зрно.
Совршен притисок за идеална крема и богата арома.
Елегантен дизајн кој совршено се вклопува во вашиот дом.
Уживајте во врвно еспресо, секое утро, без компромиси.

shots.kf: Wide 16:9 shot of a sleek, unbranded matte-black and brushed brass espresso machine sitting on a dark marble kitchen island. In the background, large windows reveal a serene morning view of Lake Ohrid. Soft, diffused morning light, cinematic 35mm lens, minimalist luxury aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly dollies from left to right across the marble counter. Steam gently rises from the top of the machine.

shots.kf: Close-up 16:9 shot of roasted, glossy coffee beans cascading inside a transparent, cylindrical hopper of the matte-black machine. Warm amber backlighting highlights the oil on the beans. Macro lens, shallow depth of field, rich earthy color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The coffee beans subtly shift and settle downwards. The camera slowly tilts up.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a polished brass steam wand releasing a burst of fine, illuminated white steam against a pure black background. Dramatic rim lighting captures the microscopic water droplets. 16:9 aspect ratio, 85mm lens, high contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The steam billows and swirls outward in slow motion. The camera slowly pushes in through the mist.

shots.kf: Close-up 16:9 shot of a bottomless brass portafilter attached to the matte-black espresso machine. A thick, dark stream of liquid espresso is just beginning to form at the bottom of the filter. Warm spotlighting, 50mm lens, dark moody background, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick, dark espresso starts to bead and form a single, slow drip. The camera holds a steady, slow zoom.

shots.kf: Macro 16:9 shot of rich, golden-brown espresso flowing smoothly into a minimalist matte-black ceramic cup. A thick layer of hazelnut-colored crema forms on the surface. Warm, inviting side-light, shallow depth of field, premium commercial styling, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The liquid espresso pours smoothly into the cup, creating tiny swirls in the crema. The camera slowly orbits the cup.

shots.kf: Medium 16:9 shot of the espresso machine and the filled ceramic cup on the marble island, framed against the bright morning light reflecting off Lake Ohrid through the window. Elegant shadows, architectural photography style, 24mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A wisp of steam rises from the cup. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal more of the kitchen's modern design.

shots.kf: Close-up 16:9 shot of the perfect cup of espresso resting on a wooden tray, with the blurred matte-black machine in the background. The morning sunlight catches the golden crema. Warm, luxurious, and inviting color palette, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The steam dances gracefully above the cup. The camera performs a slow, subtle pedestal move downwards.
